title: The meter hover: the rule, the disclaimer, and View work orders
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user with View customers, on the build under test.
  2. An asset is enrolled on a schedule with a mileage-triggered service and has a mileage reading history (e.g. unit 'ZZAUTOTEST Truck 12').
  3. Open the asset's Maintenance tab (the same estimate shows on the worklist and the work-order panel).
custom_steps:
1. Hover (or tap) the meter beneath an estimated date.
  2. Read the rule it gives and the line it ends with.
  3. Find 'View work orders' and open it.
  4. Where a card shows 'Measured from N visits', check what N counts.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The meter's hover gives the rule that produced the date (for example based on mileage estimate) and ends with: This is the system's best estimate from this unit's past readings. Check its history if in doubt.
  • Beside it, View work orders opens the asset's Work Orders tab.
  • 'Measured from N visits' counts the readings that took part in at least one usable pair; a visit whose only pairs were discarded does not count.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10568 (S11, Rate, estimate and confidence); Chunk 2 MR spec (Confluence 897679389), Part 2 / S11; read 2 Oct 2026. Source-verified 2 October 2026; not yet build-verified.
